entities.name: Query protein 210 aa
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A5CX85; sequence identity and coverage are both 100%.
Contains a CTP_transf_like domain (PF01467.33) at positions 15–185.

entities.name: A5CX85
observations: Reviewed protein annotated as probable nicotinate-nucleotide adenylyltransferase.
Catalyzes reversible adenylation of nicotinate mononucleotide to nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide.
Participates in NAD+ biosynthesis from nicotinate D-ribonucleotide.

entities.name: NaMN adenylation
observations: Nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ATP + H+ ⇌ deamido-NAD+ + diphosphate.

entities.name: NAD+ biosynthesis
observations: The reaction is the step converting nicotinate mononucleotide (NaMN) to deamido-NAD+ (NaAD) in the NAD+ biosynthetic pathway.
